E={000,011,101,110} has all six squared distances 2; 24 cube isometries preserve E and induce all S4 permutations.
Cube inversion swaps zero/unit faces; half mixture of induced densities 3 and 1 in units 3^(1/6)/2 yields uniform 2 in same units.
